prompt: Do a retrospective on the coding session in `retro-input/` (session logs, driver log and lab log, and the rework recipe it followed). It reworked this project unattended, driven by a script that played the human. Suggest improvements to the agent's environment, ranked by severity, each with the evidence that shows it. Write the report to `retro-input/RETRO.md`; change nothing else.

checks.name: only-report
checks.run: test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- . ':!retro-input')" && test -z "$(git diff HEAD --name-only -- retro-input | grep -v RETRO.md)"
